summary: Master the essentials of Compressed Natural Gas management in maritime trade. Our training course equips you with the knowledge to drive sustainable practices.
lede: CNG management for ports and maritime trade helps port, terminal, and shipping professionals assess how compressed natural gas could fit their operations. Designed for people planning, approving, or operating CNG activities, the course covers CNG properties and risks, supply and infrastructure options, and safety and emergency planning to support practical decisions about port operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in planning, approving, or operating CNG-related activities in ports and maritime trade.
audience: Shipping line and fleet operations managers
Maritime and port regulators and policy officers
HSE and risk management professionals in ports
Infrastructure planners and project managers in port
Environmental and sustainability managers in maritime logistics
Bunkering, fuel logistics, and marine service providers
modules: CNG and the Maritime Energy Transition
CNG Fundamentals for Port and Shipping Professionals
CNG Value Chain and Supply Models for Ports
Planning CNG Infrastructure in Ports and Terminals
Safety, Risk, and Emergency Management for CNG Operations
Regulatory and Standards Landscape for CNG in Maritime Settings
Commercial Models and Business Cases for CNG Projects
CNG Logistics and Daily Operations in Ports
Environmental, ESG, and Stakeholder Engagement Dimensions
Designing Your Port or Organization’s CNG Roadmap
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of port operations and some experience in maritime logistics or fuel management. Familiarity with basic safety and regulatory concepts in industrial settings is beneficial.
